title: Secure Aggregation with Pairwise Masks
learning_objectives: Generate cancelling pairwise masks from shared seeds
Recover the exact sum of updates without seeing any single update
Recover the sum when a client drops out by removing its pairwise masks
entry_point: pair_mask(i, j, dim, base_seed); mask_update(i, update, n_clients, base_seed); aggregate(masked, n_clients, dim, base_seed, dropped=())
hints: In `mask_update`, loop `j` over all other clients: add `pair_mask(i, j)` if `j > i`, subtract `pair_mask(j, i)` if `j < i`.
For dropped d and survivor s: subtract `pair_mask(s, d)` if `s < d`, add `pair_mask(d, s)` if `s > d`.

failure_feedback.advice: Client i adds m_ij for j > i and subtracts m_ji for j < i.
For each dropped d, remove the masks between d and every survivor with the right sign.
Seed each pair with default_rng([base_seed, i, j]) for i < j.
Masked updates should look nothing like the raw updates.
